jobs_results.title: Growth Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Own growth metrics, cohort analysis and campaign ROI. You will own metrics, build dashboards and run deep dives with product and business teams.

Requirements
• 2-4 years of experience in analytics
• Strong SQL and Python (Pandas)
• Power BI or Tableau dashboards
• A/B testing and statistics
• Stakeholder management and data storytelling

Nice to have
• BigQuery or Snowflake
• dbt
